:root{--face:#0d1220;--panel:#0d101de8;--rim:#43566e;--tick:#c2ccd5;--muted:#8494ac;--hour:#edf3f4;--minute:#ff995d;--second:#f34342;--cyan:#29c5c7;--green:#5bcd8b;--red:#ed464d;--digit-a:#ed459d;--digit-b:#ff9844;--tile-a:#263644;--tile-b:#a44522;--tile-c:#366185}
body{background:transparent;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif}#root{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;color:var(--hour);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}#root .panel{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:17px;background:var(--panel);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}#root .dial{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;max-height:100%;position:relative;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 39% 28%,#304052,var(--face) 70%);border:3px solid var(--rim);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #080d18,0 2px 12px #0004}#root .tick{position:absolute;height:5%;width:1.4%;border-radius:2px;background:var(--tick);opacity:.62}#root .tick.major{width:2%;height:7%;opacity:1}#root .tick.hour-0{background:var(--red)}#root .tick.hour-3{background:var(--red)}#root .tick.hour-6{background:var(--green)}#root .tick.hour-9{background:var(--green)}#root .hand{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:50%;border-radius:99px;transform-origin:bottom center;transition:transform .14s linear}#root .hand.hour{height:25%;width:5%;margin-left:-2.5%;background:var(--hour)}#root .hand.minute{height:35%;width:3%;margin-left:-1.5%;background:var(--minute)}#root .hand.second{height:38%;width:1.5%;margin-left:-.75%;background:var(--second)}#root .pin{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:9%;aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border-radius:50%;background:var(--minute);border:2px solid #fff}#root .weekday,#root .date,#root .zone,#root .date-line{color:var(--muted)}#root .digits{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:0;white-space:nowrap}#root .digit{display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:750;line-height:1;min-width:0}#root .colon{font-weight:700}#root .wide-time{font-weight:750;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--digit-a),var(--digit-b));color:transparent;background-clip:text}#root .wide-info{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:0}#root .zone{font-weight:700;color:var(--tick)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#root .hand{transition:none}}#root{display:grid;place-items:center}#root .dial{width:min(94%,94vh)}#root .hand.second{transition:none}
